data.name: Aaida
data.gender_notes: Aaida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aaida means ‘guide, helper’ or ‘she who leads’. This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘a’d’, meaning to guide or to lead. In Islamic history, Aaida is the name of several notable figures, including a wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a companion of the fourth caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib (ra). The name Aaida carries the meaning “Guide, helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaida usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and guidance in one's life.
data.etymology: Aaida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaida total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
